# Source: Dan + Johnny — LinkedIn Signals walkthrough (Vimeo)

*Vimeo "LinkedIn Signals - Topa.io", 15:47: https://vimeo.com/1233794507/cf61fad386 — pulled 2026-10-08 from the player's caption file (auto-generated captions; "TOPA"/"Smart Lead instantly" etc. as transcribed). No speaker labels: Dan asks the questions, Johnny demos. Raw material, don't edit.*

Related: [[2026-09-23-dan-jonathan-linkedin-automation-walkthrough]] [[2026-09-24-noelle-dan-johnny-setup-call]]

## Key facts for copy (all from this call)
- Two types of signal, both run daily on autopilot once set up: **profile monitoring** (scrape everyone who interacts with a named person's posts) and **keyword monitoring** (find people posting a keyword).
- Profile example: Alex Hormozi posted in the last 24 hours and 2,500+ people interacted. A coaching company on Topa scrapes his posts for that reason. Opener: "Hey, saw your comment on Alex's post."
- Topa's own profile use: scraping people who engage with Clay / Instantly / Smartlead posts → "Saw you liking Instantly's post. Have you considered LinkedIn automation?"
- Keyword example (the headline result): "insurance leads". **34 connection requests sent → 22 accepted (65%) → 19 replied = 86% response rate.** ⚠️ The emails say "92% reply rate"; this video says 86%. Reconcile before reusing the number.
- The messaging behind it: connection note "Hi [first name], saw you posted about leads." Follow-up: the DBR offer ("we offer a paid-on-result service… reactivating some of your old leads. Could we have a chat?"). Automation stops when they reply.
- Live demo: keyword "Final Expense" → 224 leads found in the last 24 hours; saved the signal; choose how many to fetch a day (20, 50, all); 82 final expense leads pulled and pushed into a new campaign during the call. Setup takes about five minutes (Johnny).
- PR firm example: keyword "just launched" → "Hey, noticed you've just launched… we'll do a PR piece for you."
- Where signal leads can go: webhook to your CRM, Instantly, Smartlead, or Topa's own LinkedIn campaigns or voicemail campaigns.
- Johnny's loose claims (attribute, don't harden): signal-led outreach "beats a crappy list like 10 times"; "five times better response rate than anything else you're doing".
- Mobile numbers: "Get cell phone" checks several databases; 7.5 cents each ("I believe the cheapest out there… can't find anyone cheaper"); about 70% hit rate. Johnny's team will even ring people when they first accept.
- **Address lookup is NOT live.** Dan: "Can we get the address yet, or is that still in the pipeline?" Johnny: "The address is still in the works… If it's a priority, I'll get it done." You can still send a physical gift from the platform, but finding the address "takes a bit of detective work". ⚠️ Emails 11.1 / 12.x say paid plans "enrich contacts to pull mobiles, emails, addresses".
- Dan's framing: relevance + timing ("reaching out at the right time… one of the most critical factors"); once the 1-2-3 handraiser is dialled in it "will just work forever" because new people post every day.
